name: gaps2-nexus-sovereignty
description: Nexus Sovereignty 'For' (audit-gaps-2, off switch TI4_RULES_AGENDAS / rulesGateAgendas). Card text: 'Alpha and beta wormholes in the wormhole nexus have no effect during movement.' pbd28@54 with the law in play (law nexus in the base save); the Wormhole Nexus (82b) is placed off-board at tl with a Deepwrought cruiser, an alpha-wormhole system (39) off-board at br. Deepwrought activates br and moves the cruiser from tl: with the law it can only arrive through the Nexus' alpha wormhole, so the move is refused (original: distance computed through the alpha wormhole, moved).
